layers.process: Gorgona National Natural Park (island): entry is only with tourist operators registered in the national tourism register (RNT) and authorised by PNN. Contact the park before paying to check carrying capacity and availability. Book at least 4 days ahead, and at least 15 days for type 1 and 2 boats. An induction talk and registration are required before entry. Guiding, transport and lodging are paid to the operators and are not in the entry fee.
